exercises.label: Question 4 — Fill in the blanks with the ordinal number in words
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Fill in the blanks with the ordinal number in words.
items: a. Bunty stood in the ___________(12) position in the line.
b. The ___________ (15) stall had the most delicious sweets.
c. Bunty's favourite song was the ___________ (18) one played at the fair.
d. The ___________ (11) book on the shelf is a mystery novel.
e. Babloo's kite was the ___________ (20) to fly in the sky.
exercises.answer_key: a. twelfth (12). b. fifteenth (15). c. eighteenth (18). d. eleventh (11). e. twentieth (20).

exercises.label: Question 5 — Identify the ordinal position of letters in ABC
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Identify the ordinal position of the following letters in ABC. The first one is done for you.
items: a. H is the ___ letter (worked example, filled in blue: 'eighth')
exercises.answer_key: Alphabet positions A=1...Z=26. a. H = eighth (8th, given as worked example). b. T = twentieth (20th). c. Q = seventeenth (17th). d. P = sixteenth (16th). e. K = eleventh (11th).
